cohort: Uterine tissues were collected from 37 patients with post-caesarean scar diverticula and 3 patients who had undergone caesarean section.
finding: CSD tissues exhibited higher expression of a-SMA, TNF-a, CD16, and CD31, and lower expression of CD163 compared to normal CS tissue, with the CD16/CD163 ratio positively correlating with inflammation, fibrosis, and neovascularisation in CSD.
mod_finding: The study identified specific inflammatory and fibrotic markers (TNF-a, a-SMA, CD16, CD31) that are overexpressed in post-caesarean scar diverticulum, a complication arising directly from caesarean section.
